name: resume-monorepo
description: Resume monorepo with web app, AI review tool, and resume source

scripts.quarto:pdf: cd resume && quarto render resume-ja.qmd --to pdf --output-dir output
scripts.quarto:html: cd resume && quarto render resume-ja.qmd --to html --output-dir output
scripts.quarto:preview:html: cd resume && quarto preview resume-ja.qmd --to html
scripts.resume:build: pnpm quarto:pdf && pnpm quarto:html && pnpm sync
scripts.review:full: cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli review --input ../../resume/resume-ja.qmd --screenshot-url http://localhost:4321/resume/ --save-iterations --verbose
scripts.reconcile: cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli reconcile interview --input ../../resume/resume-ja.qmd --project "TVODサービスの推薦システム構築" --year 2024 --verbose
scripts.draft: cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli reconcile draft
scripts.feedback: cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli reconcile feedback
scripts.review:design: bash scripts/run-with-server.sh 'cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli review --input ../../resume/resume-ja.qmd --screenshot-url http://localhost:4321/resume/ --save-iterations --verbose --auto-design'
scripts.review:design-preview: bash scripts/run-with-server.sh 'cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli review --input ../../resume/resume-ja.qmd --screenshot-url http://localhost:4321/resume/ --save-iterations --verbose --design-preview'
scripts.review:recommendation: bash scripts/run-python-server.sh 'cd packages/resume-review && python3 -m src.cli review --input ../../resume/resume-ja.qmd --target-role "Recommendation Engineer" --design-preview --auto-design --screenshot-url http://localhost:8080/resume-ja.html --save-iterations --verbose'

author: Toshihiro Yamaguchi <toshihiro.engineergmail.com>
